overview.description: The Corgi U.S. Regional Banks 2x Daily ETF (XKRE) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in financials equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of the SPDR S&P Regional Banking ETF (Ticker: KRE), which provides exposure to US regional bank stocks. XKRE was launched on Jun 3, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
